parameters.toolDescription: Returns the full index of the temet nosce knowledge graph: one block per node with its id, type, one line of notes, its directed edges, and the path of its file in the pajew-ski/temet-nosce repository. Call this first; it is the map every other tool works from. There is no query parameter, relevance is decided by reading it.

Fetches one node file from the pajew-ski/temet-nosce repository. Pass the path exactly as it appears in the path field of an index block, for example graph/nodes/this-project.md. Returns the raw markdown: YAML frontmatter (id, type, notes, edges) plus body. This is the multi-hop tool: read a node, look at its edges, decide which target matters for the question, fetch that one next, one call per hop.
parameters.url: =https://api.github.com/repos/pajew-ski/temet-nosce/contents/{{ $fromAI('path', 'The path field of an index block, for example graph/nodes/this-project.md', 'string') }}

parameters.toolDescription: Full-text search across the node file bodies of pajew-ski/temet-nosce, for when the index is not enough: the index carries only each node id, its notes and edges, not the body text. Pass plain search terms; the repo and path qualifiers are appended automatically. Returns matching file paths with text-match fragments; follow up with get_node. GitHub code search indexes the default branch with a lag of up to a few minutes after a commit.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ={{ $fromAI('query', 'Plain search terms to find in node file bodies', 'string') }} repo:pajew-ski/temet-nosce path:graph/nodes

parameters.toolDescription: Creates a new node file graph/nodes/<id>.md in pajew-ski/temet-nosce and commits it to main. Pass the node id (lowercase, hyphen separated, it becomes the filename) and the complete markdown content: frontmatter opened and closed with ---, containing id (must equal the filename), type (Project, Concept, Component, Step or Limitation), notes (a JSON array of double-quoted strings), edges (either [] or one line per edge of the form - {rel: relation_name, target: node-id}), then an optional body. Every edge target must be an existing node id from read_index. The commit triggers the repository sync action, which validates the graph and regenerates the index, so the node shows up in read_index about a minute later.
parameters.filePath: =graph/nodes/{{ $fromAI('id', 'The node id, lowercase and hyphen separated; it becomes the filename', 'string') }}.md
parameters.fileContent: ={{ $fromAI('content', 'The complete markdown file: YAML frontmatter with id, type, notes, edges, then an optional body', 'string') }}

parameters.toolDescription: Replaces the content of an existing node file graph/nodes/<id>.md in pajew-ski/temet-nosce and commits it to main. Read the current file with get_node first, then pass the node id and the complete new markdown content (same format rules as create_node); the file is overwritten as a whole, not patched. Every edge target must be an existing node id. The commit triggers the repository sync action, which validates the graph and regenerates the index automatically.
parameters.filePath: =graph/nodes/{{ $fromAI('id', 'The node id of an existing node, without path or .md extension', 'string') }}.md
parameters.fileContent: ={{ $fromAI('content', 'The complete new markdown file: YAML frontmatter with id, type, notes, edges, then an optional body', 'string') }}

parameters.toolDescription: Deletes the node file graph/nodes/<id>.md from pajew-ski/temet-nosce with a commit to main. Before deleting, check read_index for edges pointing at this node and remove them via update_node on the referencing nodes; otherwise the sync action fails its edge validation and the index stays stale. The commit triggers the sync action, which regenerates the index without the node.
parameters.filePath: =graph/nodes/{{ $fromAI('id', 'The node id of the node to delete, without path or .md extension', 'string') }}.md
